problem.title: Letter Combinations of A Phone Number

approaches.title: Iterative combination expansion
approaches.summary: Build combinations one digit at a time by duplicating the existing results for each mapped letter, then append that letter to each group. Revision 2 keeps this strategy while replacing the match-based mapping with an indexed array.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initialize results from the first digit, then expand them for each remaining digit by copying and appending mapped letters.
Replace the character match closure with an indexed array of digit-to-letter mappings; keep the iterative expansion.

approaches.title: Depth-first backtracking
approaches.summary: Recursively choose a letter for each digit, pushing and popping it in a shared buffer. Copy the completed buffer into the results at each leaf.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 17: dfs/backtrack approach with minimal cloning
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replace iterative result expansion with recursive depth-first search and a reusable mutable string buffer.
